sum_insured_options: Depends on active base policy; Plan B provides top-up over base policy sub-limits

room_rent.display: Not specified (top-up over base policy sub-limit)
room_rent.note: Plan B Benefit 1 (Proportionate Charges Cover) covers room rent and associated medical expenses over and above the sub-limit applicable in the active base policy. The base policy sub-limit acts as deductible.

icu.note: Plan B does not separately specify ICU eligibility; it operates as a top-up over the base policy.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned for Plan B.

sub_limits.note: Plan B covers over and above base policy sub-limits (room rent proportionate charges and cataract). The base policy sub-limits act as deductibles.

deductible.display: Base policy sub-limit acts as deductible (per claim basis)
deductible.note: Deductible is the sub-limit as per the active base policy, applied on a per-claim basis. Plan B cannot be opted without an active base policy.

initial_waiting.note: Standard waiting periods apply as per base policy terms.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per base policy terms applies.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailment waiting period as per base policy terms applies.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus is not mentioned for Plan B.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge is a Plan A feature; not mentioned for Plan B.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover applies as per base policy terms.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover applies as per base policy terms.

domiciliary.note: Plan B wording does not mention domiciliary hospitalisation cover.

ayush.note: Plan B wording does not separately mention AYUSH cover.

organ_donor.note: Plan B wording does not separately mention organ donor cover.

ambulance.note: Plan B wording does not separately mention ambulance cover.

modern_treatments.note: Plan B wording does not separately mention modern/advance technology treatment cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items excluded per Annexure I.

global_cover.note: Global Coverage optional benefit is not applicable for Plan B.

notable_exclusions: Cannot be used without active base policy; only covers proportionate room rent charges and cataract treatment over base policy sub-limits; maternity excluded
optional_riders: Benefit 1: Proportionate Charges Cover, Benefit 2: Cataract Treatment Cover (any combination can be opted)
